title: Wolf and Crown
author: B. M. Zhou
blurb: Paloma Voss, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
